preconditions.expression: all(c in 'ABC' for c in S) and all(c in 'ABC' for c in T)
preconditions.description: Both strings S and T consist only of characters 'A', 'B', and 'C'.
Lengths of S and T are between 1 and 10^5.
Number of queries Q is between 1 and 10^5.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a <= b <= len(S) for (a, b, c, d) in queries) and all(1 <= c <= d <= len(T) for (a, b, c, d) in queries)
preconditions.description: Each query (a, b, c, d) satisfies 1 ≤ a ≤ b ≤ |S| and 1 ≤ c ≤ d ≤ |T|.

postconditions.description: The output string has exactly Q characters.

postconditions.expression: all(output[i] in '01' for i in range(Q))
postconditions.description: Each character in the output is either '0' or '1'.

postconditions.expression: all((output[i] == '1') == is_possible(S[a-1:b], T[c-1:d]) for i, (a, b, c, d) in enumerate(queries))
postconditions.description: For each query i, output[i] is '1' if and only if T[ci..di] can be obtained from S[ai..bi] using the given transitions.
